IC1: Male [OR] or female on stable dose of IgPro20 (Hizentra) therapy.
IC2: Women of childbearing potential must be using and agree to continue using medically approved contraception (which must be discussed with the study doctor) and must have a negative pregnancy test at screening.
IC3: Subjects with PID, eg, with a diagnosis of common variable immunodeficiency [OR] or X-linked agammaglobulinemia, as defined by the Pan American Group for Immune Deficiency [OR] and the European Society of Immune Deficiencies.
IC4: With infusion parameters as specified below:
IC5: Experience with pump-assisted infusions of IgPro20 at the tolerated flow rate of 25 mL/h per injection site for at least 1 month prior to Day 1.
IC6: Total weekly IgPro20 dose of = 50 mL (= 10 g).
IC7: Experience with pump-assisted infusions of IgPro20 at tolerated volumes of 25 mL/injection site for at least 1 month prior to Day 1.
IC8: Experience with frequent (2-7 times per week) infusions of IgPro20 at the tolerated flow rate of approximately 0.5 mL/min (equivalent of 25-30 mL/h) per injection site for at least 1 month prior to Day 1. The dose (volume) per injection site should [NOT] not exceed 25 mL.
